He shot forth his beams, and scattered them: he caused great lightning, and terrified them.
And there was a shower of water, and the ground was uncovered, O LORD, from thy rebuke, from the breath of thy nostrils, and from the snorting of thy nostrils.
He sent forth from on high, and took me, and drew me up out of great waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemies, from my haters that were too mighty for me,
Which prevailed against me in the day of my calamity: and the LORD was my confidence.
And he brought me forth into the room, and plucked me out: for he had a desire toward me.
The LORD hath dealt well with me according to my righteousness: he hath rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
For I keep the ways of the LORD, and am not ungodly against my God.
For all his judgments I have before mine eyes, and his commandments I will not cast away,
But I am without change before him, and keep myself from sins.
Therefore the LORD rewardeth me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
With the saints thou art holy, and with the pious thou art pious.
And with the pure thou art pure, and with the perverse thou art perverse.
For thou helpest the wretched people, and bringest low the high eyes.
For thou shinest my light: the LORD my God maketh light my darkness.
For with thee I can smite warriors, and leap over the walls with my God.
God's ways are without change; the words of the LORD are purified. He is a shield to all who trust in Him.
For where is there a God without the LORD? or a refuge without our God?
God equips me with strength and makes my ways without change.
He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me on my high place.
He hath taught my hand to fight, and my arm to draw a bow of brass.
And thou givest me the shield of thy salvation, and thy right hand strengtheneth me; and when thou humblest me, thou makest me great.
Thou makest room to walk under me, that my ankles slip not.
I will pursue after mine enemies, and seize them, and will not return until I have slain them.
I will break them in pieces, and they shall not withstand me; they must fall under my feet.
Thou canst arm me with strength to battle; thou canst cast under me them that set themselves against me:
Thou givest me mine enemies to flee, that I may destroy mine haters.
They cry, but there is no helper; to the LORD, but he answereth them not.
I will beat them as the dust before the wind; I will clear them away as the dung of the street.
Thou savest me from the contentious people, and makest me a chief among the heathen: a people that I knew not serve me.
It obeyeth me with obedient ears: yea, the strange children have sinned against me.
the foreign children languish and wriggle in their bonds:
The LORD liveth, and blessed be my stronghold; and let the God of my salvation be exalted,
The God that giveth me vengeance, and compelleth the nations under me,
Who delivereth me from mine enemies, and exalteth me from them that set themselves against me. Thou savest me from the wicked.
Therefore will I give thee thanks, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praise unto thy name,
Who hath shewed great salvation unto his king, and his anointed, David, and his seed for ever.
a psalm of David, to be sung.
The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament proclaimeth the work of his hands.
One day telleth another, and one night telleth another.
there is no speech nor language, since one does not hear their voice.
Their cord goeth forth into all the earth, and their speech unto the end of the world: he hath made a tabernacle for the sun in them.
And the same goeth forth as a bridegroom out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a hero to run the way.
It ariseth at one end of heaven, and returneth unto the same end; and nothing is hid from the heat thereof.
The law of the LORD is without change, and restoreth the soul. The testimony of the LORD is sure, and maketh wise the foolish.
The commands of the LORD are right and gladden the heart. The commandments of the LORD are loud and enlighten the eyes.
The fear of the LORD is pure, and abideth for ever. The judgments of the LORD are true, all righteous.
They are more precious than gold, and much fine gold; they are sweeter than honey and honeycomb.
Also thy servant shall be remembered by them: and he that keepeth them hath great reward.
Who can tell how often he faileth? Forgive me the hidden faults!
Keep also thy servant from the proud, that they rule not over me: then shall I be without change, and blameless in great iniquity.
Let the words of my mouth and the conversation of my heart be acceptable unto thee, O LORD, my refuge and my redeemer.
a psalm of David, to be sung.
The LORD hear thee in thy trouble: the name of the God of Jacob save thee.
Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion.
He shall remember all thy meat offering, and thy burnt offering shall be fat. Sela.
He shall give thee that which thine heart desireth, and shall fulfil all thy purposes.
We boast that thou wilt help us; and in the name of our God we lift up our banners. The LORD grant thee all thy petition!
Now I perceive that the LORD helpeth his anointed, and heareth him in his holy heaven: his right hand helpeth mightily.
They rely upon chariots and horses: but we remember the name of the LORD our God.
They are cast down and fallen: but we stand upright.
Help, O Lord! May the King hear us when we call!
a psalm of David, to be sung.
O LORD, the king rejoiceth in thy strength; and how glad is he in thy help!
Thou givest him his heart's desire, and refuseest not what his mouth asketh. Sela.
For thou hast showered good blessings upon him; thou hast set a crown of gold upon his head.
He asketh thee for life, and thou givest him long life for ever and ever.
He hath great honour in thy help: thou layest up praise and ornament upon him.
For thou hast set him for a blessing for ever: thou hast made him to rejoice in thy countenance.
For the king hopeth in the LORD, and shall stand fast by the goodness of the most High.
Thine hand shall find all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find them that hate thee.
Thou shalt make them as a furnace of fire, when thou shalt look therein: the LORD shall devour them in his wrath. Fire shall devour them.
Their fruit shalt thou destroy from off the face of the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
For they thought to do thee evil, and made designs which they could not perform.
For thou shalt make her a shoulder; with thy sinew thou shalt aim at her face.
Arise, O Lord, in thy strength, and let us sing and praise thy might.
A psalm of David, to be sung by the hind that is hunted early.
O my God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? I cry, but my help is far off.
O my God, I call in the day, and thou answerest not; neither am I silent in the night.
But thou art holy, who dwellest under the praise of Israel.
Our fathers hoped in thee, and when they hoped, thou helpedst them out.
They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they hoped in thee, and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm, and no man; a scorn of men, and contempt of the people.
All they that see me mock me, and open their mouths, and shake their heads.
Let him complain unto the LORD, and he shall save him, and deliver him, if he have a desire toward him.
For thou hast drawn me out of my mother's womb: thou wast my confidence, when I was yet in my mother's breasts.
Unto thee am I cast from my mother's womb: thou art my God from my mother's womb.
Be not far from me, for fear is near: for there is no helper here.
Great bullocks have compassed me about, fat oxen have compassed me about;
They have opened their mouth against me like a roaring and ravening lion.
I am poured out like water; all my bones are broken in pieces; my heart is melted in my flesh like wax.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue cleaveth to the roof of my mouth; and thou layest me in the dust of death.
For dogs have compassed me about, and the wicked have made themselves round about me; they have pierced my hands and my feet.
I want to count all my legs. But you look and see their lust for me.
They divide my garments among them, and cast lots for my vesture.
But thou, O Lord, be not far off; my strength, make haste to help me.
Deliver my soul from the sword, my lonely from the dogs!
Help me out of the lion's mouth, and deliver me from the unicorns.
I will preach thy name unto my brethren, I will praise thee in the congregation.
Glorify the LORD, ye that fear him: let all the seed of Jacob glory in him, and let all the seed of Israel be afraid of him.
For he despised not the affliction of the poor, neither spurned it, nor hid his face from him: and when he cried unto him, he heard it.
Thee will I praise in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
The miserable shall eat, and be filled: and they that inquire of the LORD shall praise him: your heart shall live for ever.
Let the end of the world be remembered, that they should turn unto the LORD, and worship before him all kindreds of the Gentiles.
For the LORD hath a kingdom, and he reigneth among the heathen.
All the fat of the earth shall eat and worship: before him shall all that lie in the dust bow the knee, and they that live in want.
He shall have a seed to minister unto him: they shall proclaim of the LORD unto the children of children.
And they shall come and preach his righteousness unto the people that are born, that he may do it.
A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He maketh me to lie down in green pastures, and leadeth me beside the still waters.
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me, thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
Thou preparest a table before me against mine enemies. Thou anointest my head with oil, and pourest me out to the full.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
A psalm of David. The earth is the LORD'S, and the things that are therein; the ground, and the things that dwell therein.
For he hath founded it upon the seas, and prepared it by the waters.
Who shall go up into the mount of the LORD? and who shall stand in his holy place?
He that hath innocent hands, and is pure in heart; who hath no pleasure in loose doctrine, and sweareth not falsely.
He shall receive blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the GOD of his salvation.
This is the generation that seeketh after him, which seeketh thy face, O Jacob. Sela.
Open wide the gates, and lift up the doors of the world, that the King of glory may come in.
Who is the same king of glory? It is the LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Open wide the gates, and lift up the doors of the world, that the King of glory may come in.
Who is this same king of glory? It is the LORD of hosts; he is the king of honours. Sela.
A psalm of David. I long for thee, O Lord.
My God, I hope in thee. Let me not be put to shame, lest mine enemies rejoice over me.
For no man shall be put to shame that waiteth for thee: but they shall be put to shame that are scornful.
O Lord, shew me thy ways, and teach me thy paths.
Guide me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God that helpeth me: daily I wait for thee.
Remember, O LORD, thy mercy, and thy lovingkindness, which was from the world.
Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgression: but remember me according to thy mercy, for thy lovingkindness' sake.
The LORD is good and upright; therefore he teacheth sinners in the way.
He leadeth the wretched aright, and teacheth the miserable his way.
The ways of the LORD are goodness and truth to them that keep his covenant and his testimony.
For thy name's sake, O LORD, be merciful to my iniquity, which is great.
Who is he that feareth the LORD? He shall instruct him in the best way.
His soul shall dwell in goodness, and his seed shall possess the land.
The secret of the LORD is among them that fear him, and his covenant he maketh them to know.
Mine eyes look always unto the LORD: for he shall draw my foot out of the net.
Turn thee unto me, and be gracious unto me: for I am lonely and wretched.
the anguish of my heart is great; lead me out of my troubles!
Behold my affliction and misery, and forgive me all my sin.
Behold, mine enemies are many, and they hate me for iniquity.
Preserve my soul, and deliver me: let me not be put to shame: for I trust in thee.
Wicked and right, that keep me: for I wait for thee.
God, deliver Israel from all, its distress!
a psalm of David. O Lord, do me justice, for I am innocent. I hope in the LORD, therefore I shall not fall.
Try me, O LORD, and try me; purify my kidneys and my heart.
For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes, and I walk in thy truth.
I sit not with vain men, neither have I fellowship with the wrong.
I hate the assembly of the wicked, and sit not with the wicked.
I wash my hands in innocency, and hold myself, O LORD, to thine altar,
When the voice of thanksgiving is heard, and when all thy wonders are preached.
O LORD, I love the place of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
Lay not down my soul with sinners, nor my life with the bloodthirsty,
Which deal with evil wiles and gladly take gifts.
But I walk innocently. Deliver me and have mercy on me!
My foot goeth right. I will praise thee, O Lord, in the assemblies.
A psalm of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation: of whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
Therefore if the wicked, mine adversaries and mine enemies, desire to devour my flesh, they shall run and fall.
Though an army be arrayed against me, yet my heart feareth not: though war arise against me, yet will I rely upon him.
One thing I desire of the Lord, that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the good works of the Lord, and to visit his temple.
For he covereth me in his tabernacle in the evil time; he hideth me secretly in his tent, and exalteth me upon a rock;
And now shall I lift up my head above mine enemies that are round about me: and I will offer praise in his tabernacle, I will sing and sing praise unto the LORD.
O LORD, hear my voice when I call: be gracious unto me, and hear me.
My heart setteth before thee thy word, Ye shall seek my face. Therefore I also, O Lord, seek thy face.
Hide not thy face from me, and cast not thy servant out in anger: for thou art my help. Leave me not, and turn not thine hand from me, O GOD, my salvation!
For my father and my mother forsake me: but the LORD receiveth me.
O LORD, shew me thy way, and lead me in the paths of righteousness for mine enemies' sakes.
Give me not into the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses stand against me, and do me wrong without fear.
But I believe that I shall see the good of the LORD in the land of the living.
wait upon the LORD. Be of good courage, and of good courage, and wait upon the LORD.
A psalm of David. When I cry unto thee, O LORD my refuge, be not silent unto me; lest, when thou art silent, I be like them that go down to hell.
Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands unto thy holy choir.
Show me not among the wicked, and among the workers of iniquity, which speak kindly to their neighbour, and have evil in their heart.
Give unto them according to their deeds, and according to their wickedness; give unto them according to the works of their hands; recompense them according to their deserts.
For they will not hearken unto the works of the LORD, nor unto the works of his hands: therefore will he break them down, and not build them.
Blessed be the LORD: for he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
The LORD is my strength and my shield: in him my heart hopeth, and I am saved; and my heart is glad, and I will give thanks unto him with my song.
The LORD is their strength; he is the strength that helpeth his anointed.
Help thy people, and bless thine inheritance; and feed them, and exalt them for ever.
A psalm of David. Bring unto the LORD, ye mighty ones, bring unto the LORD glory and strength.
Bring glory to the LORD for his name; worship the LORD in holy habiliments.
The voice of the LORD goeth upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth, the LORD upon great waters.
The voice of the LORD goeth with power: the voice of the LORD goeth gloriously.
The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars: the LORD breaketh the cedars in Lebanon.
And make them lick like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
The voice of the LORD is as flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD stirreth up the wilderness: the voice of the LORD stirreth up the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD stirreth up the hinds, and uncovereth the forests. And in his temple shall all men give him glory.
The LORD sitteth to bring a flood. And the LORD remaineth a king for ever.
The LORD shall give strength unto his people: the LORD shall bless his people with peace.
A psalm to sing of the dedication of the house of David.
I praise thee, O LORD; for thou hast exalted me, and hast not caused mine enemies to rejoice over me.
O LORD my God, when I cried unto thee, thou restoredst me.
O LORD, thou hast brought my soul out of hell: thou hast kept me alive while they went into hell.
All ye saints, sing praises unto the LORD; give thanks, and praise his holiness.
For his anger endureth for a moment, and he delighteth to live: weeping endureth for the evening, but joy in the morning.
And I said, when I was well: I shall never more lie down.
For, O LORD, by thy good pleasure thou hast made my mountain strong. But when thou hidest thy face, I was afraid.
I will cry unto thee, O LORD: unto the LORD will I pray.
What profit is there in my blood, if I be dead? Will the dust also thank thee, and proclaim thy faithfulness?
Hear, O Lord, and be gracious unto me: O Lord, be my helper.
Thou hast turned my lamentation into a dance: thou hast taken off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness,
That my glory may sing unto thee, and not be still. O LORD my God, I will give thee thanks for ever.
a psalm of David, to be sung.
In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust. Let me never be put to shame; save me through your righteousness.
Incline thine ears unto me; hasten thou to help me. Be thou a strong rock and a fortress unto me, that thou mayest help me.
For thou art my rock and my fortress, and for thy name's sake thou wilt guide and lead me.
Thou wilt pull me out of the net which they have set for me: for thou art my strength.
Into thy hands I commend my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD, thou faithful God.
I hate them that hold fast loose doctrine: but I hope in the LORD.
I am glad and rejoice in thy lovingkindness, because thou lookest upon my affliction, and knowest my soul in trouble.
and deliverest me not into the hands of the enemy: thou settest my feet upon a broad place.
O Lord, have mercy upon me: for I am afraid: my frame is gone down with grief, and my soul, and my belly.
For my life is consumed with sorrow, and my days with sighing; my strength is consumed with mine iniquity, and my bones are fainted.
I am so wicked, that I am a great reproach to my neighbours, and an abhorrence to my kinsmen: they that see me in the street flee from me.
Mine is forgotten in the heart as of a dead man; I am become as a broken vessel.
For many reproach me, that all men are afraid of me: they counsel together against me, and think to take away my life.
But I, O LORD, hope in thee, and say, Thou art my God.
My time is in thy hands. Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
Let thy face shine upon thy servant: help me by thy lovingkindness.
O LORD, let me not be put to shame: for I call upon thee. The wicked shall be ashamed, and shall be ashamed in hell.
Let false mouths be put to silence, which speak against the righteous, stiffly, proudly, and scornfully.
How great is thy lovingkindness, which thou hast hid from them that fear thee, and hast shewed to them that trust in thee before men.
Thou hidest them secretly in thine own house from every man's defiance: thou hidest them in the tabernacle from the brawling tongues.
Praise be unto the LORD, that he hath shewed me a marvellous kindness in a strong city.
For I said in my anguish, I am cast out of thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications, when I cried unto thee.
Love the LORD, all ye his saints. The LORD keepeth the faithful, and rewardeth him that is proud.
Be of good cheer and of good courage, all ye that wait upon the LORD.
An instruction of David. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Blessed is the man to whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
For when I would have concealed it, my bones waxed feeble with my daily weeping.
For thy hand was heavy upon me day and night, that my sap was dried up, as it is withered in summer. Sela.
Therefore I confess my sin unto thee, and hide not my iniquity. I said: I will confess my transgression unto the LORD. Then forgavest thou me the iniquity of my sin. Sela.
For this shall all the saints pray thee in due time: therefore when great floods of waters come, they shall not reach the same.
Thou art my shield: thou wilt keep me from fear, that I may be saved, and may boast most gladly. Sela.
I will instruct thee, and show thee the way which thou shalt walk in: I will guide thee with mine eyes.
Be not as horses, and as mouths that have no understanding, which must be bridled and bitted in their mouths, if they will not come unto thee.
The wicked hath much trouble: but he that hopeth in the LORD, goodness shall compass him about.
Rejoice in the LORD, and be glad, ye righteous: and boast, all ye godly.
Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous. Let the righteous praise him beautifully.
Give thanks unto the LORD with harps, and sing praises unto him upon the psaltery of ten strings.
Sing unto him a new song; make it good on strings with sound.
For the word of the LORD is true, and what he saith he keepeth.
He loveth righteousness and judgment. The earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
The heavens were made by the word of the LORD, and all his host by the spirit of his mouth.
he holds the waters of the sea together as in a hose, and puts the depths in hiding.
Let all the earth fear the LORD, and let all that dwell upon the face of the earth be afraid of him.
For he speaketh, and it is done; and he giveth, and it is written.
The LORD destroyeth the counsel of the heathen, and turneth back the thoughts of the nations.
But the counsel of the LORD endureth for ever, the thoughts of his heart for ever.
Blessed are the people, whom the LORD is a God, the people whom he hath chosen for an inheritance.
The LORD looketh down from heaven, and seeth the children of all men.
From his high throne he looketh upon all them that dwell on the earth.
He directeth the heart of them all; he marketh all their works.
A king is not saved by his great power; a giant is not saved by his great strength;
Neither do horses help, neither doth their great strength deliver.
Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, that hope in his mercy,
That he might save their souls from death, and feed them in affliction.
Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
For our heart rejoiceth in him, and we trust in his holy name.
Thy lovingkindness, O LORD, be upon us, as we hope in thee.
A psalm of David, when he hid his countenance from Abimelech, who drove him from himself, and he departed.
I will praise the LORD alway: his praise shall be in my mouth for ever.
Let my soul glory in the LORD, that the wretched may hear and rejoice.
Praise the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
When I sought the LORD, he answered me, and delivered me out of all my fear.
Whosoever looketh on him, and runneth upon him, his face shall not be ashamed.
When this wretch cried out, the LORD hearkened, and saved him out of all his troubles.
The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
Taste and see how good the LORD is. Blessed is he that trusteth in him!
Fear the LORD, ye his saints: for they that fear him have no lack.
The rich have need and hunger: but they that seek the LORD have no lack of any thing.
Come hither, children, and hear me. I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
Who is he that desireth good living, and would fain have good days?
Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking falsely.
Forsake evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears upon their cry.
But the face of the LORD is upon them that do evil, to cut off their remembrance from the earth.
When the righteous cry, the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their affliction.
The LORD is near unto them that are of a broken heart, and helpeth them that are of a contrite spirit.
The righteous suffereth much: but the LORD helpeth him out of all these things.
He keepeth all his bones, that not one of them be broken.
Adversity shall slay the wicked, and they that hate the righteous shall be iniquitous.
The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and all they that trust in him shall have no blame.
a psalm of David. O Lord, contend with my disputers; fight against my champions.
seize the shield and weapons and set out to help me!
Draw the spear, and defend me against my persecutors. Say unto my soul, I am thy help.
They that seek my soul shall be ashamed and confounded; and they that seek me shall return and be confounded.
They shall be as chaff before the wind, and the angel of the LORD shall cast them out.
Let their way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of the LORD pursue them.
For without cause they have set their nets to destroy me, and without cause they have made pits for my soul.
He shall be taken unawares, and his net that he hath set shall take him, and be taken within.
But let my soul rejoice in the LORD, and be glad in his help.
All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee? Thou that savest the wretch from him that is too strong for him, and the poor and needy from his robbers.
Freve witnesses arise, which accuse me that I am not guilty.
They do me evil for good, to bring me to grief of heart.
And I, when they were sick, put on sackcloth, and hurt myself with fasting, and prayed always with my heart.
I held myself as if it were my friend and my brother; I walked sadly as one that mourneth for his mother.
But they rejoice in mine iniquity, and are cut off: the limpers are cut off against me without my fault: they tear, and cease not.
With them that feign and mock for the belly's sake, they gnash their teeth at me.
O Lord, how long wilt thou watch? deliver my soul from their tumult, and my lonely from the young lions.
I will give thee thanks in the great congregation; and among many people will I praise thee.
Let not them rejoice over me that are unreasonably hostile unto me, neither let them scoff with their eyes that hate me without a cause.
For they seek to do harm, and seek false things against the quiet ones of the land;
And they open their mouths wide against me, and say: There, there, we are glad to see it.
O LORD, thou seest, be not silent: O LORD, be not far from me.
Awake, and awake to my right and to my cause, my God and my Lord!
O LORD my God, judge me according to thy righteousness, that they rejoice not over me.
Let them not say in their heart, There, there, we would. Let them not say: We have devoured him.
They shall be ashamed and put to shame, all they that rejoice in mine iniquity: they shall be clothed with shame and dishonour that boast against me.
Let them boast and rejoice that grant me to be right, saying always, Let the Lord be highly praised. Praise be to the LORD, who wills his servant well!
And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness, and praise thee daily.
To sing a psalm of David the servant of the LORD.
It is spoken of the wicked from the bottom of my heart, that there is no fear of God in them.
they adorn themselves among themselves, that they may promote their evil cause, and revile others.
All their doctrine is pernicious and false: neither can they be taught that they do good,
But they seek to do harm in their camp, and stand fast in the evil way, and spare no evil.
O LORD, thy lovingkindness reacheth unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
Thy righteousness standeth as the mountains of God, and thy judgment as the great deep. O LORD, thou helpest both man and beast.
How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God, that the children of men should trust under the shadow of thy wings!
They shall be of the riches of thy house, and thou shalt water them with lust as with a river.
For with thee is the living fountain, and in thy light we see the light.
Spread thy lovingkindness over them that know thee, and thy righteousness over the upright.
Let not the proud tread me down, neither let the hand of the wicked overthrow me,
But let them that do evil fall there, that they may be cast out, and not remain.
a psalm of David. Be not angry with the wicked; be not envious of the transgressors.
For as the grass they shall soon be cut down, and as the green herb they shall wither.
Hope in the LORD, and do good; dwell in the land, and feed thyself honestly.
Delight thyself in the LORD: he shall give thee that which thy heart desireth.
Commend thy ways unto the LORD, and hope in him: he will do it well.
And shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
Be still unto the LORD, and wait for him. Be not angry with him to whom his will is happily gone.
Depart from wrath, and leave off anger: be not wroth, that thou do evil.
For the wicked shall be cut off: but they that wait upon the LORD shall inherit the earth.
It is yet for a little, that the wicked is no more: and when thou shalt look for his place, he shall be gone.
But the wretched shall inherit the land, and have pleasure in great peace.
The wicked dreadeth the righteous, and gnasheth his teeth at him.
But the LORD laugheth at him: for he seeth that his day cometh.

a psalm of David in remembrance.
O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy wrath.
For thine arrows are in me, and thy hand is upon me.
There is no soundness in my flesh from thy wrath, neither is there peace in my bones from mine iniquity.
For my sins are upon my head, as a heavy burden they have become too heavy for me.
My wounds stink and fester from my folly.
I walk crookedly, and very stooping: all the day long I walk sadly.
For all my loins are withered: there is no soundness in my body.
It is very different with me, and I am very sore troubled. I howl with the unrest of my heart.
O LORD, all my desire is before thee, and my groaning is not hid from thee.
My heart is troubled, my strength is gone out of me, and the light of my eyes is not with me.
My beloved and my friends stand against me, and shun my plague; and my neighbours stand afar off.

For I am made to suffer, and my pain is always before me.
For I acknowledge my iniquity, and make provision for my sin.
But mine enemies live, and are mighty: they that hate me unreasonably are great.
And they that do me evil for good set themselves against me, because I hold fast that which is good.

Thou hast devoured us like sheep, and scattered us among the heathen.
Thou sellest thy people for nought, and takest nothing for it.
Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

For we are slain daily for thy sake, and are esteemed as sheep for the slaughter.

For our soul is bowed down to the earth; our belly cleaveth to the ground.

a psalm of David from the roses, to be sung.
God, help me; for the water is come up to my soul.
I sink in deep mire, because there is no bottom: I am in deep water, and the flood will drown me.
I have cried with a sore voice, my throat is sore: my face is sore, because I have waited so long for my God.
They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. They that are unreasonably hostile unto me, And destroy me, are mighty. I must pay for that which I have not stolen.
O God, thou knowest my folly, and my debts are not hid from thee.
Let not them that wait for thee, O LORD of hosts, be ashamed of me. Let not them that seek thee, O God of Israel, be ashamed in me.
For thy sake I bear reproach, my face is full of shame.
I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and unknown unto my mother's children.
For I am almost jealous for thine house: and the reproach of them that reproach thee is upon me.
And I weep, and fast bitterly; and they mock me for it.
I have put on sackcloth; but they make a mockery of it.
They that sit in the gate wash of me; and in the taverns they sing of me.
But I pray thee, O LORD, in due season. God, through your great goodness, hear me with your faithful help!
Deliver me out of the dung, that I sink not; that I may be delivered from mine haters, and from the deep waters,
Lest the flood of waters drown me, and the deep swallow me up, and the hole of the pit close upon me.
Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is acceptable: turn thee unto me according to thy great mercy.
And hide not thy face from thy servant: for I am afraid: hear me speedily.
Make thee my soul, and deliver it: deliver me for mine enemies' sake.
Thou knowest my reproach, my shame, and my disgrace: mine adversaries are all before thee.
The reproach breaketh my heart, and grieveth me. I wait to see if any will mourn, but there is none; and for comforters, but I find none.
And they give me gall to eat, and vinegar to drink in my great thirst.
Let their table become a snare before them, a retribution and a trap!
Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and let their loins always be troubled.
Pour out thy displeasure upon them, and let thy fierce anger seize them.
Let their habitation be desolate, and let none dwell in their tents.
For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten, and boast that thou hast smitten thine own with evil.
Let them fall into one sin upon another, that they come not unto thy righteousness.
Blot them out of the book of the living, that they be not written with the righteous.
But I am wretched, and I am in woe. God, your help protect me!
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will highly honor him with thanksgiving.
This shall please the LORD better than a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
The wretched see and rejoice; and those who seek God, their hearts will live.
For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
Let heaven, earth, and sea, and all that moveth therein, praise him.
For God shall help Zion, and build the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there, and possess them.
And the seed of his servants shall inherit them, and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

make haste, O GOD, to save me, O LORD, to help me!
They that desire my soul shall be ashamed and confounded: they that wish me ill shall return and be heard,

Save me by thy righteousness, and deliver me: incline thine ear unto me, and help me.
Be thou a stronghold unto me, whither I may always flee, who hast promised to help me: for thou art my rock and my fortress.
My God, save me from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and the tyrant.
For thou art my confidence, O Lord, my hope from my youth.
In thee have I trusted from my mother's womb: thou hast drawn me out of my mother's womb. My glory is always from thee.
I am as a wonder before many: but thou art my strong assurance.
Let my mouth be full of thy glory and thy praise daily.
Cast me not away in my old age: forsake me not when I am faint.
For mine enemies speak against me, and they that hold upon my soul take counsel with one another.
And say: God has forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is no savior!
God, be not far from me; my God, make haste to help me.
They that are against my soul shall be ashamed, and perish: they that seek my evil shall be covered with shame and scorn.
But I will always wait, and will always make thy glory more.
My mouth shall declare thy righteousness, thy salvation daily, which I cannot number.
I walk in the strength of the LORD GOD: I praise thy righteousness alone.
God, thou hast taught me from my youth: therefore declare I thy wonders.
Neither forsake me, O God, in my old age, when I am gray, until I declare thy arm to my children's children, and thy strength to all that are to come.
O God, your righteousness is great, you who do great things. God, who is like you?
For thou hast made me to know much and great fear, and hast restored me to life, and brought me up out of the depth of the earth.
thou makest me very great, and comforteth me again.
So I also thank thee with psaltery for thy faithfulness, O my God: I sing praises unto thee upon the harp, O holy one in Israel.
My lips and my soul, which thou hast redeemed, are glad and sing unto thee.
My tongue also doth daily commune with thy righteousness. For they that seek my evil shall be ashamed and confounded.
To the God of Solomon, give thy judgment unto the king, and thy righteousness unto the king's son,
That he may bring thy people to righteousness, and save thy afflicted ones.
Let the mountains bring peace among the people, and the hills righteousness.
He shall uphold the wretched people in judgment, and shall help the poor, and shall smite the blasphemers.
They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, from child to child.
He shall descend as the rain upon the hide, as the drops that wet the land.
In his days shall the righteous flourish, and great peace, till the moon be no more.
He shall reign from sea to sea, and from the waters even unto the end of the world.
Before him shall they bow that are in the wilderness; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
The kings of the sea and of the isles shall bring gifts: the kings of Arabia and Seba shall bring gifts.
All kings shall worship him, all nations shall serve him.
For he shall deliver the poor that crieth, and the needy that hath no helper.
He will be gracious to the lowly and to the poor, and will help the souls of the poor.
He shall redeem her soul from deceit and from iniquity, and her blood shall be esteemed in his sight.
He shall live, and they shall give him of the gold of Arabia. And they shall pray before him continually; daily shall they praise him.
In the earth, upon the top of the mountains, shall the corn stand thick; the fruit thereof shall quake as Lebanon, and shall green in the cities as grass upon the earth.
His name shall be for ever: as long as the sun endureth, his name shall reach unto his seed, and they that are blessed by him shall be blessed: all the heathen shall praise him.
Blessed be the LORD God, the LORD God of Israel, which alone doeth wonders;
And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let all the earth be filled with his glory. Amen, amen.

they are not in misfortune like other people and are not afflicted like other people.

a teaching of Assaph. God, why do you even reject us and are so fiercely angry with the sheep of your pasture?

Thou shalt divide the sea by thy strength, and shatter the heads of the dragons in the waters.

Thou wilt not give the soul of thy turtledove unto the beast, nor forget thy wretched beasts.

Let not the lowly go away with shame: for the poor and the miserable glorify thy name.

I will open my mouth for proverbs, and speak out ancient history,
Which we have heard, and know, and which our fathers have told us,
That we should not refrain from their children that come after, and declare the glory of the LORD, and his power, and the wonders which he hath done.
He established a testimony in Jacob, and gave a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers to teach their children,
That their seed might learn, and the children that should be born after them, when they were grown up, might tell it also unto their children,
That they might put their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, and keep his commandments,
And became not as their fathers, an apostate and disobedient sort, whose heart was not steadfast, neither did their spirit hold fast to God;
As the children of Ephraim, which had the bow in their hand, fell away in the day of battle.
They kept not the covenant of God, neither would they walk in his law,
And they forgot his deeds, and his wonders which he had shewed them.
In the sight of their fathers he did wonders in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
And he divided the sea, and let them go through it: and he set up the waters as a wall.
He led them by day with a cloud, and by night with a bright fire.
He plucked up the rocks of the wilderness, and watered them with water abundantly;
And he made rivers to flow out of the rock, and they went down like rivers of water.
Yet they continued in sin against him, and provoked the most high to anger in the wilderness;
And tempted God in their heart, that they might require meat for their souls;
And they spake against God, saying: Yes, God should be able to prepare a table in the wilderness!
Behold, he hath smitten the rock, and the waters have flowed, and the rivers have flowed: but how can he give bread, and provide meat for his people?
And it came to pass, when the LORD heard it, that he was kindled, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath came upon Israel,
That they believed not in God, and hoped not for his help.
And he commanded the clouds above, and opened the doors of heaven;
And he caused the man to rain upon them to eat, and gave them bread from heaven.
They did eat angel's bread: he sent them meat abundantly.
He made the east wind to blow under heaven, and by his strength he stirred up the south wind.
And rained flesh upon them as dust, and birds as the sand of the sea;
And he cast them down under their beds in every place where they dwelt.
And they did eat, and were filled: and he made them atone for their lust.
When therefore they had repented of their lust, and were yet eating thereof,
And the wrath of God came upon them, and slew the chief of them, and smote the best of Israel.
But over all this they sinned still more, and believed not his miracles.
Therefore he sent them away to die, and they obtained nothing; and they were afflicted all their days.
And when he slew them, they sought him, and turned early unto God.
And they remembered that GOD is their refuge, and GOD the Most High is their Redeemer,
And pretended unto him with their mouth, and lied unto him with their tongue.
But their heart was not set on him, neither did they keep his covenant faithfully.
But he was merciful, and forgave iniquity, and destroyed it not; and turned away his wrath often, and let not all his anger go.
For he remembered that they are flesh, a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
They provoked him often to anger in the wilderness, and provoked him to indignation in the desert.
They tempted GOD again and again and mastered the Holy One in Israel.
They remembered not his hand the day that he delivered them from their enemies,
As he did his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the land of Zoan,
For he turned their waters into blood, that they could not drink their brooks;
For he sent vermin among them, which devoured them, and toads, which corrupted them,
And gave her increase to the caterpillars, and her seed to the locusts;
When he smote their vines with hail, and their mulberry trees with locks;
When he smote their cattle with hail, and their flocks with beams;
When he sent evil angels among them in his fierce anger, and made them rage and rage, and did them wrong;
For he sent away his wrath, and spared not their souls from death, and caused their cattle to die of the pestilence;
When he smote all the firstborn in Egypt, the firstborn in the tabernacles of Harn.
And he sent forth his people as sheep, and led them as a flock in the wilderness.
And he led them safely, that they feared not: but their enemies covered the sea.
And brought them into his holy border, unto this mountain which his right hand hath purchased:
And before them the nations, and divided unto them the inheritance, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in those tents.
But they tempted and provoked God Most High to anger, and did not keep His testimonies;
And they fell back, and despised all things, as their fathers did, and kept not, as a loose bow;
And they provoked him to anger with their high places, and provoked him with their idols.
And when God heard it, he was inflamed, and rejected Israel greatly,
That he made his tabernacle to go to Shiloh, the tabernacle where he dwelt among men;
And gave their power into prison, and their glory into the hand of the enemy;
And delivered up his people to the sword, and burned upon his inheritance.
their young men were eaten up by the fire, and their virgins were left unfreed.
Her priests fell by the sword, and were no widows to weep.
And he, O LORD, awoke as one that sleepeth, as one that is strong rejoiceth from wine,
And smote his enemies from behind, and put them to an everlasting shame.
And rejected the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim,
But mentioned the tribe of Judah, mount Zion, which he loved.
And built up his sanctuary on high, as a land that shall stand firm for ever.
And he chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
He took him from the lambs that were suckling, that he should feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
And he also fed them with all faithfulness, and ruled them with all diligence.
A psalm of Assaph. O LORD, the heathen have fallen into thine inheritance, and have polluted thy holy temple, and made Jerusalem a heap of stones.
They have given the carcases of thy servants for meat unto the fowls of the air, and the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
They shed blood round about Jerusalem like water; and there was none to bury it.
We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a scorn to them that are round about us.
O Lord, how long wilt thou be angry, and let thy zeal burn like fire?
Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.
For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his houses.
Remember not our former iniquity: have mercy upon us quickly; for we are become almost thin.
help us, O GOD, our helper, for the glory of your name; save us and forgive us our sin for the sake of your name!
Why hast thou made the heathen say, Where is their God? Let the vengeance of the blood of thy servants, which is shed, be made known among the heathen before our eyes.
Let the groaning of the captives come before thee: according to thy great arm keep the children of death.
And sevenfold recompense our neighbours in their bosoms for their reproach, because they have reproached thee, O LORD.
And we thy people, and the sheep of thy pasture, give thee thanks for ever, and proclaim thy praise for ever and ever.
a psalm of Assaph from the span roses, to be sung.
Thou shepherd of Israel, hear, thou that tendest Joseph as the sheep; appear, thou that sittest over cherubims.
Awaken thy power, which is before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, and come to our help.
God, comfort us, and make thy face to shine, and we shall be healed.
O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry with the prayer of thy people?
Thou feedest them with the bread of tears, and waterest them with a great measure of tears.
Thou hast set us at variance with our neighbours, and our enemies have mocked us.
O God of hosts, comfort us. Let your face shine, and we shall be healed.
Thou hast brought up a vine out of Egypt, and hast cast out the heathen, and planted the same.
Thou hast made the way before him, and hast rooted him, and he hath filled the land.
mountains are covered with his shadow, and with his branches the cedars of GOD.
Thou hast spread forth his plant unto the sea, and his branches unto the waters.
Wherefore then hast thou broken down his fence, that all that pass by may break it down?
The wild swine have rooted him up, and the wild beasts have destroyed him.
O God of hosts, turn thou, look down from heaven, and behold, and seek out this vine.
And keep him in the building which thy right hand hath planted, and which thou hast firmly chosen for thyself.
Look ye in, and rebuke, that there be an end of burning and tearing.
Let thine hand guard the people of thy right hand, and the people whom thou hast chosen for thyself,
Then we will not depart from thee. Let us live, and we will call upon thy name.
O LORD of hosts, comfort us. Let your face shine, and we shall be healed.
to sing on the githith: Assaph.
Sing joyfully to God, who is our strength; rejoice to the God of Jacob.
Take the psalms, and give the timbrels, and the harps, and the psalteries.
Blow ye the trumpets in the new moon, in our feast of the leafy bosom.
For this is the way of Israel, and the right of the God of Jacob.
These things he set forth for a testimony unto Joseph, when they came out of the land of Egypt, and heard a strange language,
When I had unburdened her shoulder, and her hands were loosed from the pots.
When thou calledst upon me in trouble, I helped thee: and when the weather overtook thee, I hearkened unto thee, and tried thee by the water of the Hader. Sela.
Hear, my people, I will testify among you; Israel, you shall hear me,
That there be no other god among thee, neither that thou worship any strange god.
I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt. Open thy mouth wide, and let me fill it.
But my people will not hearken unto my voice, neither will Israel hearken unto mine.
So have I left them in the folly of their hearts, to walk after their counsel.
If my people would be obedient unto me, and if Israel would walk in my way,
I will soon subdue their enemies, and turn mine hand upon their adversaries;
And they that hate the LORD shall lack him: but their days shall be for ever.
And I would feed them with the best wheat, and satisfy them with honey out of the rock.
a psalm of Assaph. God stands in the company of God and is judge among the gods.
How long will ye judge iniquity, and prefer the person of the wicked? Sela.
Render justice to the poor and to the fatherless, and help the needy and the poor to righteousness.

But they suffer them not, nor hearken unto them; they go always in darkness: therefore must all the foundations of the land fall.
I have said, Ye are gods, and the children of the Most High;

God, arise and judge the land: for thou art an inheritor over all the nations.
a psalm song of Assaph.
God, do not be so silent, and do not be so still; God, do not pause so!
For, behold, thine enemies rage, and they that hate thee lift up their heads.
They make crafty plots against thy people, and counsel against thy hidden ones.
Behold, they say, let us cut them off, that they be no nation, that the name of Israel be no more remembered.
For they have joined themselves together, and made a covenant against thee:
The tents of the Edomites, and of the Ishmaelites, and of the Moabites, and of the Hagarites,
The Gebalites, and the Ammonites, and the Amalekites, and the Philistines, with them of Tyre;
Asshur also joined them, and help the children of Lot. Sela.
Do unto them as unto the Midianites, as unto Sisserah, as unto Jabin by the brook Kishon,
Which were consumed at Endor, and became dung upon the earth.
Make their princes like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunah,
Who say, We will take the houses of GOD.
God, make them like a whirlpool, like stubble before the wind!
As a fire burneth up the forest, and as a flame kindleth the mountains,
So pursue them with thy weather, and terrify them with thy tempest.
Make their faces full of shame, that they may ask thy name.
They shall be ashamed, and shall be afraid more and more, and shall be ashamed, and shall perish.
And they shall know that by thy name thou art called Lord alone, and the most high in all the earth.
a psalm of the children of Korah, to be sung on the githith.
How goodly are thy dwelling places, O LORD of hosts!
My soul desireth and longeth for the courts of the LORD: my body and soul rejoice in the living God.
For the bird hath found a house, and the swallow her nest, where they lay young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King and my God.
Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they praise thee for ever. Sela.
Blessed are the men that count thee their strength, and walk after thee with their hearts,
Who pass through the vale of tears, and make wells there. And the teachers are adorned with many blessings.
They get one victory after another, that it must be seen that the right God is in Zion.
O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Sela.
O God, our shield, look; behold the kingdom of thine anointed!
For one day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I will rather keep the door of my God's house, than dwell long in the tabernacles of the wicked.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD giveth grace and honour: he will not fail the good of the upright.
O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
a psalm of the children of Korah, to be sung.
O LORD, which hast been merciful unto thy land in time past, and hast redeemed the captives of Jacob;
Who hast formerly forgiven the iniquity of thy people, and covered all their sin, Sela;
Thou that didst lift up all thy wrath before, and didst turn away from the fierceness of thine anger;
Comfort us, O GOD our Saviour, and remove your displeasure from us.
Wilt thou then be angry with us for ever, and let thy wrath go for ever and ever?
Wilt thou not then restore us, that thy people may rejoice over thee?
O Lord, show us your mercy and help us!
Oh that I should hear that God the LORD speaketh, that he should promise peace unto his people and to his saints, that they should not enter into folly!
But his help is near unto them that fear him, that glory may dwell in our land;
That goodness and faithfulness meet together, righteousness and peace kiss each other;
That faithfulness may grow upon the earth, and righteousness look down from heaven;
That the LORD also may do us good, that our land may yield her increase;
That righteousness nevertheless may abide before him, and walk in the sword.
A prayer of David. O Lord, incline thine ears, and hear me; for I am wretched and poor.
Keep my soul: for I am holy. Help, O my God, thy servant, who trusteth in thee.
Lord, have mercy upon me: for I cry unto thee daily.
Make glad the soul of thy servant: for after thee, O LORD, do I desire.
For thou, O LORD, art good and gracious, of great kindness unto all them that call upon thee.
Hear, O LORD, my prayer, and hearken unto the voice of my supplications.
In trouble I call upon thee; thou wilt hear me.
O LORD, there is none like thee among the gods, neither is there any that can do like thee.
All the nations which thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O LORD, and shall honour thy name,
That thou art so great, and doest wonders, and art alone GOD.
Thy way, O LORD, that I may walk in thy truth: keep my heart in that which is one, that I may fear thy name.
I thank thee, O LORD my God, with all my heart; and I honor thy name for ever.
For great is thy lovingkindness toward me, and thou hast delivered my soul from the depths of hell.
O God, the proud are set against me, and the company of the oppressors are after my soul, and have not thee before their eyes.
But thou, O LORD God, art merciful and gracious, patient, and of great kindness and faithfulness.
Turn thee unto me, be gracious unto me: strengthen thy servant with thy might, and help the son of thy handmaid.
Do a sign unto me, that it may be well with me, that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed, that thou standest by me, O LORD, and comfortest me.
a psalm song of the children of Korah. It is firmly established on the holy mountains.
The LORD loveth the gates of Zion above all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are preached in thee, O city of God. Sela.
I will preach unto Rahab and Babylon, that they may know me. Behold, the Philistines and the Tyrians and the Moors are born there.
And it shall be said in Zion, that all manner of men shall be born therein, and that he that is most high shall build them.
The LORD shall preach in divers tongues, that some of them also shall be born there. Sela.
And the singers, as at the round dance, shall all sing in thee one by one.
A psalm-song of the children of Korah, to be sung, of the infirmities of the wretched. An instruction of Heman the Ezrahite.
O LORD God, my Saviour, I cry before thee day and night.
Let my prayer come before thee; incline thine ear unto my cry.
For my soul is full of sorrow, and my life is nigh unto hell.
I am esteemed like unto them that go down to hell: I am like a man that hath no help.
I lie forsaken among the dead, as the slain that lie in the grave, of whom thou rememberest no more, and they are separated from thy hand.
Thou hast laid me down in the pit, in darkness, and in the deep.
thy wrath oppresseth me, and presseth me with all thy floods. Sela.
Thou hast put my friends far from me: thou hast made me an abomination unto them. I lie captive, and cannot get along.
My form is pitiful with misery. O Lord, I call upon thee daily; I stretch forth my hands unto thee.
Wilt thou then do wonders among the dead, or shall the dead arise and thank thee? Sela.
Shall thy goodness be told in graves, and thy faithfulness in destruction?
May thy wonders be known in darkness, or thy righteousness in the land that is not remembered?
But I cry unto thee, O LORD; and my prayer cometh early before thee,
Why hast thou, O LORD, cast off my soul, and hid thy face from me?
I am wretched and faint, that I am so cast down; and I suffer thy terror, that I am almost consumed.
Thy wrath is upon me; Thy terror oppresseth me. They compass me about daily as waters, And compass me about together.
Thou makest my friends, and my neighbours, and my kinsmen, to depart from me, because of this affliction.
a teaching of Ethan the Esrahite.
I will sing of the grace of the LORD for ever, and declare his truth with my mouth for ever,
Saying thus, That an everlasting mercy shall spring up, and thou shalt keep thy truth faithfully in heaven.
I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn to David my servant:
I will provide seed for thee for ever, and will build thy throne for ever. Sela.
And the heavens, O Lord, shall praise thy wonders, and thy truth in the congregation of the saints.
For who in the clouds is like unto the LORD, and is like unto the LORD among the children of the gods?
God is almost mighty in the gathering of the saints and wonderful over all who are around Him.
O LORD God of hosts, who is like thee, a mighty God? And thy truth is round about thee.
Thou hast dominion over the boisterous sea; thou stillest the waves thereof when they rise.
Thou smitest Rahab to death; thou scatterest thine enemies with thy strong arm.
Heaven and earth are thine; thou hast founded the ground, and all that is therein.
The midnight and the noonday hast thou made; Tabor and Hermon exult in thy name.
Thou hast a mighty arm; strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
Righteousness and judgment are the stronghold of thy throne: mercy and truth are before thy face.
Blessed are the people that rejoice. O LORD, they shall walk in the light of thy countenance.
They shall rejoice daily over thy name, and be glorious in thy righteousness.
For thou art the glory of their strength, and by thy grace thou shalt exalt our horn.
For the LORD is our shield, and the Holy One of Israel is our King.
At that time thou spakest in vision unto thy holy one, saying: I have raised up a hero to help; I have raised up a chosen one from among the people;
I have found my servant David, I have anointed him with my holy oil.
My hand shall sustain him, and my arm shall strengthen him.
Enemies shall not overcome him, and the unrighteous shall not subdue him,
But I will smite his adversaries before him, and them that hate him will I afflict.
But my truth and my mercy shall be with him, and his horn shall be exalted in my name.
I will put his hand into the sea, and his right hand into the waters.
And he shall call me thus, Thou art my Father, my God, and my stronghold, which helpeth me.
And I will make him the first son, the chiefest among the kings of the earth.
I will keep my mercy for him for ever, and my covenant shall be steadfast unto him.
I will give him seed for ever, and will keep his throne all the days of heaven.
But where his children forsake my law, and walk not in my statutes,
If they profane my statutes, and keep not my commandments,
I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with plagues.
But I will not turn away my mercy from him, neither will I fail in my truth.
I will not profane my covenant, nor change that which hath gone out of my mouth.
I have sworn once by my holiness, I will not lie unto David.
His seed shall be for ever, and his throne before me as the sun;
As the moon he shall be preserved for ever, and as the witness in the clouds he shall be sure. Sela.
But now thou hast transgressed, and forsaken, and been wroth with thine anointed.
Thou destroyest thy servant's covenant, and troddest his crown to the ground.
Thou shalt break down all his walls, and shalt cause his strongholds to be broken down.
All that pass by rob him: he is become a mockery to his neighbours.
Thou exaltest the right hand of his adversaries, and rejoicest all his enemies.
Thou hast also taken away the power of his sword, and hast not let him prevail in the battle.

thou shortenest the time of his youth, and coverest him with scorn. Sela.
O LORD, how long wilt thou hide thyself, and let thy wrath burn like fire?
Remember how short my life is! Why would you have created all men in vain?
Where is there any that liveth, and seeth not death, to deliver his soul out of the hand of hell? Sela.
O LORD, where is thy former mercy, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
Remember, O LORD, the reproach of thy servants, which I bear in my bosom of so many nations of all,
That thine enemies, O LORD, may revile thee, that they may revile the footsteps of thine anointed.
Be the LORD forever! Amen, amen.
a prayer of Moses, the man of God.
O LORD God, you are our refuge for ever and ever. Before the mountains were created, and the earth and the world, you are, O God, from everlasting to everlasting,
who let men die, and said, Come again, children of men.
For a thousand years are before thee as the day that was yesterday, and as a night watch.
Thou hast caused them to pass away like a river, and they are as a sleep, as grass that fadeth quickly,
Which flourisheth early, and withereth soon, and is cut down in the evening, and withereth.
This is thy wrath, that we are consumed: and thy fury, that we are consumed suddenly.
For thou hast set our iniquity before thee, our unconcealed sin in the light of thy countenance.
Therefore all our days are consumed in thine anger: we have spent our years as a tale.
Our life shall be seventy years; and if it come to pass, it shall be fourscore years: and if it have been good, it shall have been toil and trouble: for it shall pass quickly, as if we flew away.
And who shall believe that thou art angry? and who shall be afraid of thy wrath?
Teach us to remember that we must die, that we may be wise.
O Lord, turn again to us, and be gracious unto thy servants.
Fill us early with thy grace, and we will glory and be glad all our days.
Now make us glad again, after that thou hast afflicted us so long, after that we have suffered misfortunes so long.
Show thy servants thy works, and thy glory to their children.
And the LORD our God be kind unto us, and promote the work of our hands among us; yea, promote the work of our hands. The 91st Psalm, (^) Comfort in Dying.
He who sits under the umbrella of the Most High and abides under the shadow of the Almighty,
Who saith unto the LORD, My confidence and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.
For he delivereth me from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
He shall cover thee with his wings, and thy confidence shall be under his wings. His truth is shield and screen,
That thou shouldest not be afraid of the terror of the night, of the arrows that fly by day,
From the pestilence that creepeth in darkness, from the pestilence that wasteth in the south.
Though a thousand fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand, it shall not come upon thee.
Yea, thou shalt see thy lust with thine eyes, and shalt see it rewarded unto the wicked.
For the LORD is thy confidence, the most High is thy refuge.
No evil shall befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy tabernacle.
For he hath commanded his angels concerning thee, to keep thee in all thy ways,
That they bear thee up in their hands, and that thou dash not thy foot against a stone.
Thou shalt walk upon the lions and the vipers, and tread upon the young lions and dragons.
He desireth me, and I will help him: he knoweth my name, and I will defend him;
If he call upon me, I will hear him. I am with him in trouble; I will pluck him out, and make him honourable.
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.

This is a good thing, to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O thou most High.

For, O LORD, thou hast made me to sing joyfully of thy works, and I have glorified the works of thy hands.
O Lord, how great are thy works! Thy thoughts are so very deep.
A foolish man believeth not, and a fool regardeth not these things.
The wicked flourish as the grass, and the transgressors all flourish, until they be destroyed for ever and ever.
But thou, O LORD, art the most high, and abidest for ever.
For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, behold, thine enemies shall perish; and all evildoers must be scattered.
But my horn shall be exalted as the horn of a unicorn, and shall be anointed with fresh oil.
And mine eye shall see his delight in mine enemies, and mine ear shall hear his delight in the wicked that set themselves against me.
The righteous shall be green as a palm tree; he shall grow as a cedar in Lebanon.
They that are planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
And though they grow old alike, yet they shall flourish, and be fruitful and fresh,
That they may proclaim that the LORD is my stronghold, and that there is no wrong in him.
The LORD is king, and gloriously adorned: the LORD is adorned, and hath begun a kingdom as far as the earth is, and hath prepared it to abide.
From this time thy throne is established: thou art for ever.
O Lord, the rivers of waters arise, the rivers of waters lift up their roar, the rivers of waters lift up the waves.
The waves of the sea are great, and roar exceedingly: but the LORD is greater in the height.
Thy word is a right doctrine. Holiness is the ornament of thy house for ever.
O Lord God, who is vengeance, God, who is vengeance, appear!
Arise, thou judge of the world: recompense to the proud their due.
O LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the ungodly boast?
And speak so defiantly, and all evildoers boast so?
O LORD, they smite thy people, and afflict thine inheritance.
